intro.Simple: Alex needs to cross the river. Fix the bridge by solving two fraction puzzles.
intro.Moderate: Alex the fox has reached a river. Solve two fraction puzzles to rebuild the bridge and reach the castle.
intro.Rich: Beyond the emerald meadow, the gates of Fraction Fortress shimmer in the distance. Alex the fox must restore the ancient river bridge by solving two fraction puzzles.

refresher.Simple: A fraction is part of a whole. Half of 8 means 8 split into 2 equal groups.
refresher.Moderate: A fraction represents equal parts of a whole. To find one-half of 8, divide 8 into two equal groups.
refresher.Rich: Every bridge stone belongs to a larger whole. A fraction describes equal shares: one-half of 8 means separating 8 stones into two equal groups.

success.Simple: More bridge pieces appear! Keep going.
success.Moderate: Alex places another set of stones. The bridge is taking shape!
success.Rich: With a satisfying click, another stretch of golden stones locks into place. The path to the fortress grows stronger!

finale.Simple: You finished the bridge! Alex can cross.
finale.Moderate: The bridge is complete, and Alex can finally reach the castle!
finale.Rich: The last stone settles into place. The river glitters below as Alex crosses the restored bridge and arrives at the gates of Fraction Fortress!

questions.prompt: The bridge has 8 stones. How many stones are in 1/2 of the bridge?

narrative.Simple: Alex sees 8 stones. Find half to help fix the bridge.
narrative.Moderate: Alex finds eight stones by the river. Work out how many make up half of them.
narrative.Rich: At the riverbank, Alex discovers eight weathered stones. To restore the first stretch of the bridge, determine how many stones form one-half of the collection.

questions.prompt: A second section has 12 stones. How many stones are in 1/4 of it?

narrative.Simple: There are 12 more stones. Find one-fourth.
narrative.Moderate: Alex finds twelve more stones. Work out how many make up one-quarter of them.
narrative.Rich: A second pile of twelve stones waits beside the fortress river. Alex needs one-quarter of that pile to finish the crossing.
